comparison.objective: Infer a pointed-at item and deliver it upright to a tray; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Gesture interpretation, selective grasping, and upright placement versus hex-key use, counterholding, fine adjustment, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Only the indicated item is upright on the tray and others remain unmoved versus two acceptable stops with no bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: Human-cue grounding and selective fetching are meaningfully different from damper tuning.
